jobs.title: IN-DOH-Oral Health Educator
jobs.description:
The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. Oral Health Educator Job Description: Overview:\u2028The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. This position will focus on equipping Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), school nurses, educators, children and families, and community partners with the knowledge and skills needed to support oral hygiene practices, preventive care, and improved oral health outcomes. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description:
Position type is Long term contract Opportunity
Location:- Okemos or Farmington, Michigan - 3 Days Onsite/Week 
Type of Interview:- Both Virtual (1st round will be a Teams call) and F2F (Witll be a Final round) is Must 
Job Summary: 
We are seeking a forward-thinking SDET to help modernize and lead our test automation strategy. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable, maintainable, and integrated test automation frameworks across UI and API layers using modern tools like Playwright and TypeScript, while also contributing to CI/CD testing integration. The SDET will also play a key role in supporting manual testing efforts within Agile feature teams—guiding test case design, exploratory testing, and quality validation for areas not yet automated. This position is critical to enabling feature teams to take ownership of both automated and manual testing, ensuring faster, higher-quality releases. 
Primary Responsibilities: 
1.      Partner with Agile feature teams to understand user stories, define acceptance criteria, and promote a test-first mindset through collaboration in design and refinement sessions. 
2.      Build, maintain, and evolve test automation frameworks using Playwright (preferred), TypeScript, or other enterprise-approved tools to support API and UI testing. 
3.      Drive the transition from legacy frameworks (e.g., Selenium + Java, Postman/Newman) to unified automation aligned with our CI/CD strategy. 
4.      Collaborate with developers and QA engineers to ensure test cases are executed in CI pipelines and provide fast, actionable feedback. 
5.      Support feature teams with manual testing efforts when needed, including test case design, exploratory testing, and validation of complex workflows that are not yet automated. 
6.      Develop and maintain automated API tests (REST/SOAP) and end-to-end tests that validate functional and non-functional requirements. 
7.      Participate in code reviews and contribute to test architecture decisions to ensure reliability, reusability, and scalability of test assets. 
8.      Write and maintain SQL queries to validate data integrity and support test data creation strategies. 
9.      Serve as a quality engineering champion—helping guide automation strategy, mentoring peers, and contributing to continuous improvement of QA practices. 
10. Ensure traceability between requirements, tests, and defects, and support compliance with enterprise policies (e.g., HIPAA, security, audit readiness). 
Preferred Experience: 
·       Hands-on experience with Playwright (TypeScript preferred) or similar frameworks like Cypress. 
·       Migration experience from Selenium + Java or Postman to modern frameworks. 
·       Familiarity with test reporting, dashboarding, and quality metrics in a DevOps environment. 
·       Experience with test case management tools (e.g., qTest, QMetry, TestRail) and requirements traceability.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Healthcare Project Manager to lead and coordinate healthcare projects from initiation through completion. The ideal candidate will manage project planning, stakeholder communication, budgets, timelines, risk management, and cross-functional teams while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations and organizational goals.
 
Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, monitor, and close healthcare projects within scope, schedule, and budget. 
Develop project plans, timelines, resource allocation, and project documentation. 
Coordinate with clinical, operational, IT, and business stakeholders. 
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies. 
Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to leadership. 
Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, quality standards, and organizational policies. 
Manage project budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement activities. 
Facilitate meetings, prepare reports, and maintain project documentation. 
Lead change management initiatives and support user adoption. 
Track project KPIs and recommend process improvements. 
Resolve project issues and escalate critical concerns when necessary. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Nursing, Information Technology, or a related field. 
5–8 years of project management experience, preferably in healthcare. 
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously. 
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid). 
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. 
Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, or Monday.com. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related field). 
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification. 
Experience with Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR) implementations. 
Knowledge of healthcare regulations such as HIPAA (or applicable regional healthcare compliance requirements).

jobs.title: Test Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview
Engagement Details

Duration: 9 months
Start: Immediate
Location: [Onsite – Irvine, CA or Portland, OR ]
Extension: Possible based on program needs

Need local consultants 
Client  is seeking an experienced Test Manager to lead and drive end-to-end testing.
This is a contractor role responsible for establishing, managing, and executing the overall testing strategy across a complex, multi-system environment. The Test Manager will partner closely with Global IT, business stakeholders, PMO, and Testing-as-a-Service (TaaS) teams to ensure high-quality delivery, governance, and readiness for deployment.
The role requires strong leadership across System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression and readiness cycles, ensuring alignment with defined entry/exit criteria, defect thresholds, and governance expectations.


Key Responsibilities
1. Test Strategy Execution & Leadership

Lead execution of the Project Testing Strategy, ensuring alignment with program objectives, scope, and governance.
Drive testing across all phases:

·        



System Integration Testing (SIT1, SIT2)
User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
User Dress Rehearsal (UDR)
Regression testing 


Ensure risk-based testing prioritization, focused on critical business processes, integrations, and controls.



2. Test Planning & Governance

Develop and govern detailed test plans, schedules, and execution models aligned with the integrated program plan.
Define and enforce entry/exit criteria, readiness checkpoints, and test cycles.
Ensure complete requirements traceability (RTM) and coverage of all business processes.
Work with PMO to establish and maintain RACI, reporting cadence, and governance forums.



3. Cross-System Integration Testing Oversight

Lead testing across a complex application landscape, including:

·        



SAP S/4HANA
Salesforce
Kinaxis
Hyperion / Anaplan
Ariba
Other enterprise and homegrown applications


Ensure validation of:

·        



End-to-end business processes
Data migration, reconciliation, and conversion
Interfaces (inbound/outbound)
Security roles and controls
Reporting and analytics





4. Test Execution Management

Oversee test execution using qTest ALM for:

·        



Test planning and repository management
Script execution tracking
Defect lifecycle management
Reporting and dashboards


Coordinate with  Global TaaS teams, SMEs, and IT delivery teams for smooth execution.
Ensure test scripts are designed, reviewed, approved, and executed with proper evidence.



5. Defect & Quality Management

Own defect triage, prioritization, and resolution governance.
Ensure defects are tracked, categorized, and resolved within thresholds:

·        



No critical/high defects at phase exit
Defined pass-rate thresholds (e.g., 90–95% for SIT, 100% for UAT)


Drive root cause analysis and regression validation.
Provide daily defect and testing status reporting to leadership.



6. Business Engagement & UAT Leadership

Partner with business stakeholders to:

·        



Define UAT scope and scenarios
Support business testers during execution
Ensure complete validation of business processes


Drive UAT sign-off and deployment readiness decisions.



7. Environment & Data Readiness

Ensure readiness of:

·        



Test environments (SIT, UAT, Dress Rehearsal)
Test data (mock cutovers, converted data)


Coordinate environment dependencies and readiness milestones with IT and PMO.



8. Reporting & Executive Communication

Provide daily/weekly test status reporting, including:

·        



Execution progress
Defect metrics
Risk and issue tracking


Present updates to senior leadership and governance forums.
Escalate risks proactively with mitigation plans.



Required Qualifications
Experience

12+ years of experience in enterprise application testing/programs
8+ years hands on Test Manager / Test Lead roles
Proven experience leading testing for large-scale ERP transformations or integrations
Strong experience with multi-system integration programs
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

Functional & Technical Expertise

Deep understanding of:

·        



SAP S/4HANA testing
Enterprise SaaS platforms (Salesforce, Ariba, Anaplan, Kinaxis)


Experience in: 

·        



End-to-end business process testing (OTC, P2P, SCM, Finance, etc.)
Data migration and reconciliation validation
Interface and integration testing





Testing Tools & Methodologies

Hands-on experience with:

·        



qTest (Highly preferred) or similar ALM tools


Strong expertise in:

·        



Test lifecycle management
Defect management frameworks
Requirements traceability
Risk-based testing





Leadership & Soft Skills

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience working with:

·        



Global teams
Business SMEs
IT delivery and PMO organizations


Excellent communication and executive presentation skills
Ability to manage complex, high-pressure program timelines



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in merger/integration programs (highly desirable)
Familiarity with Testing-as-a-Service (TaaS) models
Experience in semiconductor or manufacturing industry
Knowledge of SOX controls and audit validation processes



Key Success Metrics

On-time completion of SIT, UAT, and readiness cycles
Achievement of defined pass rates and defect thresholds
Full requirements traceability and coverage
Successful UAT sign-off and deployment readiness
Quality of reporting and stakeholder alignment

The Contract Marketing Manager – Wealth Management will serve as a project manager and consultative partner to ensure continuity of wealth marketing initiatives during a planned leave. The primary objective of this engagement is to keep active projects moving forward, maintain alignment across affiliate and enterprise marketing teams, and steward wealth marketing materials and integrations.

Project & Program Management 
•          Manage and coordinate active wealth marketing initiatives, ensuring timelines, deliverables, approvals and budget remain on track.

•          Partner with cross‐affiliate marketing teams to integrate wealth management messaging into client‐facing campaigns.

Strategic & Consultative Support

•          Maintain consistency with existing strategies rather than developing new marketing architectures.
 
Out‐of‐Scope

Deliverables

•          Update and organize wealth marketing materials library

•          Transition notes and recommendations at end of contract

Engagement Success Criteria

•          Marketing assets remain current, centralized, and accessible

We are looking for a skilled and driven Senior Firewall Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, deployment, and ongoing support of secure, scalable network infrastructures. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong foundation in enterprise firewall technologies, particularly Palo Alto Networks, and Fortinet, along with working knowledge of Cisco infrastructure products.
You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining advanced security solutions, leading firewall migrations, and ensuring the integrity and performance of network security systems. A key part of this role involves using industry-standard migration tools to transition legacy systems to modern platforms with minimal disruption.
The ideal candidate brings a proactive approach to problem-solving, a deep understanding of network security principles, and the ability to work across teams to align security strategies with business goals. Experience in multi-vendor environments and a willingness to adapt to evolving technologies will be highly valued.
 
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and maintain secure network infrastructures using Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, and Cisco routing and switching products.
• Lead and support firewall migration projects, including policy analysis, configuration translation, and deployment using tools such as Expedition, FortiConverter, SmartMove, and other vendor utilities.
• Build and deploy new network security infrastructures, including greenfield implementations and expansion of existing environments.
• Perform security policy reviews, rulebase optimization, and threat prevention tuning to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex network security issues across multi-vendor environments, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (network, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams) to integrate security controls into enterprise architecture.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including network diagrams, configuration standards, and operational procedures.
• Monitor and respond to security events, alerts, and incidents, escalating as necessary and contributing to root cause analysis and remediation.
• Participate in a rotational on-call schedule to provide after-hours support for critical network security incidents and maintenance activities.
• Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies to continuously improve the organization’s security posture.
 
Required Qualifications:

Job Summary: 
The Principal, IT Contracts Manager serves as a trusted authority on contractual matters for our client IT, overseeing the full contract lifecycle from intake through transition to operations with a focus on our most complex and impactful agreements. This role plays a critical part in protecting the organization’s legal, financial, and operational interests by ensuring contracts are well-structured, compliant, commercially sound, and aligned with business strategy. This position partners closely with IT leaders, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Vendors to enable efficient contract execution while managing risk. 
 
Key Accountabilities / Job Functions:
Accountability 1- Contract Drafting & Review (40%)

Collaborate with IT leaders and vendors to ensure contract language accurately reflects business intent, scope, pricing, timelines, performance obligations, and risk allocation.
Review, edit, and finalize a broad range of IT contracts, including but not limited to:


Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
Statements of Work (SOWs)
Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Contract Amendments
Other vendor and supplier agreements

 
Accountability 2- Negotiation & Risk Management (5%)

Collaborate with Sourcing and Legal to support contract negotiations with vendors and IT leaders, balancing pricing and legal risk with business objectives.
Partner with IT leaders, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, and Risk to ensure contracts include:


Security control obligations, audit rights, vulnerability remediation timeframes, and breach notification.
Data handling and regulatory clauses relevant to travel (PII, and PCI where applicable).
Business continuity/DR obligations (RTO/RPO), resiliency testing, and subcontractor controls.                                                                                                                                                    

Accountability 3 - Compliance & Governance (5%)

Ensure contracts comply with internal policies, and industry standards.
Support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal controls related to contractual obligations.
Ensure proper approvals, signatures, and recordkeeping are completed in accordance with company governance standards.                                                                                      

 
Accountability 4 - Contract Lifecycle Management (5%)

Manage contract lifecycle, including intake, drafting, review, execution, storage, renewal, amendment, and termination.
Maintain an organized, searchable contract repository using contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools or internal systems.
Ensure post-execution obligations are clearly communicated to relevant internal teams.              

 
Accountability 5 - Stakeholder Collaboration (25%)

Ensure governance in place for managed service contracts and provide oversight.          
Partner with Sourcing on pricing, payment terms, and cost controls.
Ensure vendor and supplier agreements follow IT, Financial, Sourcing and Legal processes. 
Collaborate with IT Leaders to ensure vendor and supplier agreements meet operational needs.
Serve as a primary point of contact for contract-related inquiries across the organization.
Advise internal stakeholders on termination rights, and dispute resolution provisions where needed.
Ensure proper approvals, signatures, and recordkeeping are completed in accordance with company governance standards.

 
Accountability 6 - Process Improvement & Knowledge Management (10%)

Develop and maintain standardized contract templates, clause libraries, and negotiation playbooks.
Recommend and implement improvements to contract processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and turnaround time.
Provide training and guidance to internal teams on contract basics, best practices, and risk awareness.
Support implementation or optimization of contract management systems.              

 
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities needed:            
"Scope:  This role owns the end‑to‑end lifecycle of all IT contracts, acting as the organization’s internal authority on commercial, legal, and operational contract matters.
It spans drafting, negotiation, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.

Job Title: Principal Architect with healthcare
Location: 2 days a week onsite in Mount Arlington, NJ- locals or nearby candidates only

Pay rate: $75/hr on C2C
Exp Level: 14+ years

SUMMARY:

The Principal Architect is a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader responsible for defining and advancing MedPro’s target-state architecture, platform modernization strategy, and cross-product technical direction. 


This role partners directly with the VP of Engineering, engineering leads, product stakeholders, Data Operations, and IT/Security to move MedPro from a collection of independently built legacy and modern products toward a coherent, scalable platform company.


This role does not manage people or own a separate budget. It leads through technical authority, execution, influence, credibility, and clear decision frameworks. 


The Principal Architect is expected to design, prototype, and help deliver critical reference implementations while guiding teams toward common patterns, reusable capabilities, and intentional modernization decisions.


A central focus of the role is DataFlow, MedPro’s strategic in-house data platform and shared foundation for acquiring, mastering, matching, exploring, securing, and distributing MedPro data. 


DataFlow is intended to become the common internal and external interface for data capabilities across MedPro, replacing duplicated patterns and fragmented systems over time through disciplined modernization and incremental migration.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Define and maintain MedPro’s technical North Star, target-state architecture, and modernization principles in partnership with the VP of Engineering.


Own the architecture vision for DataFlow as MedPro’s shared data platform foundation, including identity integration, role-based access control, data acquisition, master data management, matching and merging, search, data exploration, standard extracts, outbound data services, APIs, and shared platform capabilities.


Translate the DataFlow vision into pragmatic architecture patterns, phased migration plans, and reference implementations that engineering teams can adopt incrementally.


Design and lead strangler-pattern modernization approaches that allow MedPro to replace legacy Oracle/PLSQL, Classic ASP, .NET, and other legacy components without halting product delivery.

Business Analyst - Digital Product Support (B2C & B2B)
Location:  Remote — United States
Team:  Digital Product & Data. | Type : Contract 3 months

Any Visa
MOI- Virtual
 

 

About the Role
We are building a dedicated product-support function to own the product side of defect management and customer-support enablement across our B2C (consumer loyalty) and B2B (provider portal and platform) digital products.
This role is the connective tissue between Customer Support, Product, and Engineering. When production issues arise, you are the product-side owner who investigates, triages, assigns severity, and drives issues to resolution in partnership with CS and the delivery team. When the queue is quiet, you focus on making support better -  optimizing CS processes, capturing CS requirements into the product backlog, and ensuring CS has the tools and training they need.
It is a high-impact role for someone who is equally comfortable digging into a bug, writing a crisp defect ticket, and stepping back to improve how a support organization runs.
Key Responsibilities
Defect & Production Support (primary)

Serve as the product-side first point of contact for the CS and commercial teams for production issues across the B2C and B2B digital platforms.
Investigate and reproduce reported issues; gather evidence (logs, screenshots, recordings, repro steps) and document defects clearly.
Assign severity and impact using a defined rubric, and recommend priority. 
Partner with Customer Support to confirm business impact and align on priority for fix resolution (P1, P2 etc).
Coordinate with Engineering and the delivery/vendor team on resolution; track each issue to closure and keep CS and stakeholders updated on status and ETAs.
Maintain the production defect backlog; identify recurring issues and surface root-cause themes to Product and Engineering.

CS Process Creation/Optimization & Requirements (steady-state)

Partner with CS, Product and Commercial on creating CS process. 
During lower-incident periods, analyze and improve CS processes and workflows for loyalty and platform support.
Gather, document, and prioritize CS requirements for CS tools and also identify product needs basis escalations/bugs; translate them into user stories and backlog items for product and tooling needs.
Own and groom the CS tooling backlog in partnership with Product.

CS Tooling & Enablement

Own the product-side responsibility for the tools and platforms CS relies on — configuration needs, enhancements, and access.
Develop and deliver CS tool training, runbooks, and documentation so CS has the capabilities and information/knowledge to support customers independently.
Build and maintain a knowledge base for common issues and resolutions.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

Act as product-side first point of contact for CS and commercial teams to investiage and report production bug for resolution based on priority matrix. 
A clear, shared severity/priority rubric and triage process in place, with CS and Product aligned on how issues flow. 
Product-team time spent on reactive support measurably reduced.
A groomed CS tooling backlog and delivered processes or tooling needs. 
CS equipped and trained on the platforms they use day to day to be able to support customers independently. 

Qualifications
Required

3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Support Analyst, or similar role supporting B2C and/or B2B digital products (web/mobile apps, e-commerce, CRM, or loyalty platforms).
Hands-on defect management experience: triage, reproduction, severity/priority frameworks, and disciplined ticket hygiene.
Proficiency with issue trackers (e.g., Jira) and support/ticketing tools (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk).
Strong written communication and documentation skills; able to translate between non-technical CS partners and technical Engineering teams.
Self-directed and organized in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
Comfortable collaborating across time zones with offshore delivery teams.

Preferred

Experience with Salesforce (Loyalty Cloud/Experience Cloud / Commerce) and/or headless web platforms. Twilio experience is a plus.
Basic data querying skills (SQL; Snowflake a plus) to investigate issues independently.
Experience standing up or maturing a support/triage function.
Familiarity with release processes, feature flags, and environment management.
Background in aesthetics, healthcare, or another regulated industry.

Core Competencies

Investigative mindset — methodical at reproducing and isolating issues.
Judgment — calibrates severity and priority sensibly against real business impact.
Partnership — builds trust with CS, Product, and Engineering; holds healthy boundaries on ownership.
Bias for clarity — turns ambiguity into well-documented tickets, requirements, and process.

Performs detailed analysis of Palo Alto Networks firewall security policies to identify optimization opportunities, including consolidation, tightening, and removal of unused or redundant rules.

Maintains comprehensive documentation of analysis findings, decisions, and migration readiness status.
Contributes to the development of standardized processes, templates, and criteria for the policy review effort.
Adheres to change management requirements and processes.
Participates in project planning, status reporting, and stakeholder communications.
Identifies and escalates complex policy conflicts or architectural questions to the Analyst III / project lead.

 
Desired Qualifications:

3–5 years of experience in firewall administration, network security, or a related cybersecurity role.
Solid hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls and Panorama management.
Experience analyzing and optimizing large-scale firewall rule bases in an enterprise environment.
Working knowledge of SASE/SSE concepts and Palo Alto Prisma Access is a plus.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, NAT, routing, and common network protocols.
Ability to develop and refine firewall policy while balancing business requirements and security controls.

•         Experience analyzing firewall security and traffic logs for policy validation.
•         Palo Alto Networks PCNSA required; PCNSE preferred.
•         CompTIA Security+ or equivalent preferred.
•         Experience in a large enterprise or critical infrastructure environment preferred.

jobs.description:
The Role
This is a backend-focused Data Engineer role centered on building and maintaining large-scale ETL pipelines that consolidate financial data from multiple business lines into a centralized data platform. The engineer will develop and support Apache Spark batch jobs written in Scala, manage data movement across AWS services, and ensure reliable processing of large datasets into Cassandra for downstream portfolio management and financial planning applications. The role also involves consuming REST and SOAP APIs with Java, working with Snowflake and cloud-based data storage, monitoring and troubleshooting batch processing, and deploying scalable data solutions that support secure, token-based integrations with external FinTech partners. Candidates should have at least 8 years of experience, with 10+ years preferred.

This is a true Data Engineering position with a strong emphasis on ETL development rather than analytics or reporting. The primary technology stack includes Scala, Apache Spark, AWS (EMR, RDS, IAM, KMS, S3, SNS, Lambda), Cassandra, Snowflake, Control-M, Java, REST/SOAP APIs, and large-scale data formats such as Parquet. Python is considered a nice-to-have but is not part of the core pipeline development. The day-to-day work focuses on aggregating data from multiple financial platforms—including brokerage, retirement, insurance, charitable, and custody systems—into a centralized Cassandra database, enabling advisors and third-party applications to securely access comprehensive financial information for investment advice, portfolio management, and financial planning.

jobs.description:
Overview:          
        
TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients worldwide.  
Our client is a recognized prominent global enterprise in the automotive sector, listed among the top 50 companies in the Global Fortune rankings. As a leading player in the global automotive industry, our client manufactures vehicles in 27 countries and effectively markets them across over 170 countries and regions worldwide. 
     
Position: CW Computer Vision Engineer
Location: Mountain View, CA 94043
Duration: 12 Months         
Job Type: Temporary Assignment 
Work Type: Onsite  
   
Job Description:
 

Position Summary:

Develop proof-of-concept (POC) computer vision systems for intelligent mobility and in-vehicle applications. 
The role focuses on rapidly evaluating, implementing, and deploying state-of-the-art computer vision and AI technologies on vehicle-grade edge computing platforms, bridging cutting-edge research and real-world intelligent mobility systems.

Responsibilities:

Develop proof-of-concept systems using state-of-the-art AI and computer vision technologies.
Design and implement computer vision algorithms for object detection, tracking, semantic/instance segmentation, 3D scene understanding, visual localization, mapping, driver and occupant monitoring, and behavior recognition.
Build solutions using modern AI approaches including Vision Transformers (ViT), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Multimodal AI, Foundation Models, Self-Supervised Learning, and Generative AI.
Evaluate and adapt the latest research papers and open-source models to automotive and intelligent mobility applications.
Integrate camera, vehicle, and sensor data to create innovative AI-driven applications.
Develop and integrate AI software on embedded and edge computing platforms for in-vehicle applications.
Design real-time perception systems operating under vehicle constraints including compute, memory, latency, power consumption, and robustness.
Optimize AI models for deployment on automotive SoCs, GPUs, and AI accelerators.
Prototype and evaluate end-to-end systems on vehicle platforms, embedded devices, and research vehicles.
Develop software for deployment and demonstration in vehicle-based proof-of-concept platforms.
Evaluate tradeoffs among accuracy, latency, memory footprint, and operational robustness.
Collaborate with researchers, software engineers, and system engineers to realize innovative concepts and demonstrations.
Stay up to date with emerging trends in computer vision, multimodal AI, edge AI, and intelligent mobility systems.

Required Qualifications:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong background in Computer Vision and Machine Learning.
Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, or similar frameworks.
Experience implementing and training deep learning models including CNNs, Transformers, Vision Transformers (ViT), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and multimodal architectures.
Strong programming skills in Python and C++.
Experience reading, reproducing, and extending recent AI/CV research publications.
Familiarity with Linux development environments.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Foundation Models, Large Vision Models, and Multimodal AI systems.
Experience with CLIP, SAM (Segment Anything), DINOv2, BEV-based perception models, or similar state-of-the-art vision technologies.
Experience with Generative AI and synthetic data generation.
Experience developing software on embedded Linux systems.
Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or comparable inference optimization frameworks.
Experience optimizing and deploying AI models on edge devices and automotive computing platforms.
Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, NVIDIA DRIVE, Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride, or similar embedded AI platforms.
Experience with ROS/ROS2, sensor fusion, or robotic/automotive systems.
Experience in automotive, robotics, autonomous systems, or intelligent transportation systems.
Publications in leading AI, robotics, or computer vision conferences are a plus.

jobs.description:

Location: Bloomington, MN 55435
Job Type: Temporary Assignment
Duration: 12 Months 
Work Type: Onsite
 
Job Summary

We are seeking an Lab Clean-up and Inventory Specialist. 
This role plays a critical part in reclaiming valuable lab space, reducing clutter, and improving overall lab organization through informed technical judgment. 
The Lab Clean up and Inventory Specialist is a hands on, technician focused contract role responsible for assessing underutilized lab areas and determining appropriate disposition of parts and materials. 

About the role – you will: 

Systematically review unused and underutilized lab spaces to identify stored parts, materials, tools, and equipment.  
Assess parts and materials to determine keep or discard based on technical relevance, condition, and potential future use. 
Reduce clutter and reclaim lab space by coordinating removal, consolidation, or disposal of obsolete or unnecessary items. 
Organize retained parts and materials in a logical, accessible manner to support current and future lab needs. 
Document findings using simple tools (e.g., spreadsheets, lists, photos) to summarize retained items and disposition decisions. 
Coordinate with engineering, lab owners, and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) teams to ensure proper handling and compliant disposal practices. 
Perform work in an active lab environment while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations. 
Maintain professionalism, safety awareness, and respect for sensitive lab equipment and materials. 

About you: 

Hands on experience in a technical lab, manufacturing, or engineering environment (technician level background strongly preferred). 
Strong technical familiarity with parts, materials, and lab equipment, enabling informed decisions about value and applicability. 
Proven ability to independently assess, organize, and clean up physical workspaces. 
Comfortable working in physically active roles involving standing, walking, bending, and light to moderate lifting.
 Demonstrated organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to document work clearly and accurately using basic digital tools. 
Good judgment, reliability, and ability to work with minimal supervision. 

Your experience includes: 

Knowledge in hard disk drive or semi-conductor manufacturing environment is preferred 
Post-secondary education is preferred 
Experience with Microsoft Office

jobs.description:
Overview:         
     
TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world-wide. Our client is a trusted engineering, construction and project management partner to industry and government. Differentiated by the quality of their people and their relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, they align their capabilities to their customers’ objectives to create a lasting positive impact. Since 1898, they helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.       
     
Job Title: CT Field Eng Piping Professional
Location: Portland,TX 78374
Duration: 12 Months
Job Type: Temporary Assignment 
Work Type: Onsite  
       
JOB DESCRIPTION:  
 
Project Overview: 

The Cheniere Corpus Christi Liquefaction (CCL) Project is a Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) export facility located on the north shore of Corpus Christi Bay in Gregory, Texas. 
The 1,000+ acre facility started bulk early works in July 2015 as the first greenfield export facility in the country. 
Client has successfully and safely completed construction, and it now consists of three operating Trains with an LNG production capacity of approximately 15 million tons per year (MTPA), three LNG storage tanks with combined capacity of 480,000 cubic meters of LNG, 2 Jetty superstructures that can accommodate the world’s largest vessels, and dozens of associated buildings and utilities.
Corpus Christi Liquefaction Project Stage 3 (CCL3) is a new phase at the existing CCL facility and will consist of seven midscale liquefaction trains with an LNG production capacity of approximately 10 MTPA, and associated infrastructure including utilities.

Job Summary: 

The Piping Field Engineer will report to the Lead Piping Field Engineer. 
This individual is responsible for providing technical assistance, direction, and support to field supervision for piping and/or testing construction and installation activities for all disciplines associated with their assigned Area equipment and materials. 
The Piping Field Engineer may be required to support the Pipe Testing team depending on the needs of the project. 
Must be willing to work a flexible schedule if required, including, but not limited to nightshift, split shift, or day shift. 
 

Major Responsibilities: 

Performing inspections and initiating supporting documentation for all discipline system installations on an ongoing basis. 
Providing support to field supervision in establishing requirements for workforce, tools, equipment, and material requirements for a given work evolution. 
Preparing short- and long-term schedules, and interfacing with the superintendents and other discipline field engineers. 
Executing field material takeoffs from "Issued For Construction" drawings. 
Providing input to the quantity tracking applications and reporting on weekly installed quantities to Project Controls. 
Preparing field material requisitions for equipment and materials, and monitoring status of purchase orders and deliveries. 
Trouble-shooting the design, resolving issues with engineering and/or fabricator using formal field documentation processes. 
Ensuring all installations are per latest revisions of design drawings, specifications, standards, and codes. 
Acting as point of contact for coordination and resolution of all technical issues related to select contractors on site who provide technical services for the execution of the permanent plant piping systems scope of work. 
Completing and verifying quality documentation per inspection and test plans. 
Completing final system walk-downs, deficiency tracking and close-out. 
Completing and reviewing as-built documentation. 
Monitoring actual work performance compared to the project budget and schedule Responsibilities in support of Piping Testing may include: Support all activities related to Testing, Flushing, Hydro jetting, Bores coping, Blowing /Drying, Cleanliness and Restoration. 
Assisting in development, creation, reviewing, approving, and issuing Pneumatic, Hydrostatic, Service and Visual test packages. 
Assisting the verification and witnessing of acceptance of tests. 
Assisting in development, creation, reviewing, approving, and issuing Pneumatic Test Safety Plans. 
Control and maintain master set of Test Package PIDs. 
Identify, purchase, implement control and track piping test material and test equipment. 
Conduct Pneumatic and hydrostatic pressure tests. 
Review and approve Inspection and Test Plans pertaining to Pipe Testing and Cleanliness. 
Support the establishment of procedures on testing of piping systems.

Education and Experience Requirements: 

University/B.S. degree in Civil Engineering plus 6 years of experience or 10 years equivalent industry experience in-lieu of a degree.

Required Knowledge and Skills: 

Construction experience assigned to a construction site. 
Knowledge of engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience. 
Demonstrated ability to motivate team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment.  
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations. 
Good knowledge in MS Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and other common applications used on the construction industry. 
Experience on an LNG construction site especially along the U.S. Gulf Coast. 
Experience managing technical services subcontracts. 
Understanding of applicable client work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures. 
Familiarity with client Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Setroute, Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, and other automation tools which are used on client projects.

Additional Information: 

Work includes field inspections and the physical ability to conduct field inspections which require the following activities: extensive walking in and around a construction site often in high heat and high humidity conditions, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces and working in small or confined spaces. 
Some lifting may be required. 
Must have the ability to walk into and out of the project (enter/egress). 
Must be able to use appropriate standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) required for each assigned task (i.e. harness, life vest, lift buckets, etc.).

Assistant Manager of Fabric R&D

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand – our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

In this role, you are accountable for supporting the ideation, development, implementation and execution of the Gap Inc production and vendor capability strategy, delivering value through effectively balancing innovation, quality, and cost. You will be able to operate in a highly matrixed global organization, forming part of the cross functional product team (Design, Merchandising, Tech Design, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, Fabric Research and Development and Global Sourcing). · Execute category product development strategies that align with production strategies and divisional goals.

Who You Are

· Global Product Development experience or exposure to driving global product development and understands design, merchandising, and vendor/category management.
· Problem Solver- can proactively solve problems and effectively manage multiple challenges. Anticipate and mitigate P2M risks by balancing cost, supplier and time constraints
· Collaboration- Proven ability influencing and making decisions cross-functionally in a matrix environment where speed and cultural sensitivity is crucial.

jobs.title: 11985-1 - Change Management Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Seeking a Senior Change Manager to lead organizational change management (OCM) delivery across the NextGen Procurement transformation program. This enterprise initiative modernizes Gap's procurement operating model through sequential technology implementations — Zip intake orchestration, Coupa Supplier Information Management, and Ironclad Contract Lifecycle Management — serving procurement, accounts payable, legal, as well as various business functions and supplier-facing teams across the organization.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact engagement requiring expert change management execution across four concurrent releases culminating in an enterprise rollout by December 2026. The program will transform how Gap manages supplier relationships, contract execution, and procurement processes for thousands of users globally, making skilled OCM leadership essential to adoption success.
The right candidate brings direct experience supporting procurement or enterprise P2P transformations and can operate independently to manage content production, training development, and stakeholder coordination while collaborating closely with the Change Lead who handles strategic relationships and executive sponsorship.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own comprehensive communications production across all four releases — developing message strategies, creating publish-ready email campaigns, drafting town hall materials, and executing reinforcement communications tailored to procurement, AP, legal, supplier management, and business partner audiences.
• Design, develop, and coordinate training curriculum and content delivery for Zip, Coupa SIM and Ironclad CLM implementations, including foundational learning content, step-by-step user guides, quick reference materials, and enterprise training execution framework for integrated solution rollout.
• Execute detailed stakeholder impact assessments for contract management deployment, using current state vs. future state workflows for legal, procurement, and business functions to list and analyze change impacts, while identifying high-resistance stakeholder segments and change magnitude across process, tool, role, and data dimensions.
• Manage enterprise-wide coordination activities for global, multi-region deployment including cutover complexity planning, regional process variation management, multi-language material development, and coordinated change champion network operations across time zones.
• Drive readiness assessment and deliverable completion for enterprise rollout, ensuring all enablement materials meet publish-ready quality standards and coordinating with SI vendors (KPMG, Epiq) to ensure content integration and delivery excellence.
• Support integrated solution change management by managing compounded change from SIM→CLM→P2P workflow integration, developing orchestrated change sequencing to prevent user saturation, and creating end-to-end process training that builds on previous solution learning.
• Execute comprehensive program reporting and stakeholder participation including regular status updates, governance meeting participation, cross-functional coordination with product and technical program managers, and collaborative planning with Change Lead on strategy alignment.
• Handle localization requirements and ERC updates for international markets, developing region-specific content variations and managing enterprise communication platform coordination for global deployment success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Human Resources, Communications, or related field.
• 5+ years of change management experience, with a minimum of 3 years specifically supporting procurement, supplier management, P2P function, or similar stakeholders through enterprise system implementations.
• Direct experience supporting enterprise platform implementations (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle Procurement, or similar platforms). Candidates must be able to credibly engage users on platform concepts without requiring technical onboarding.
• Experience independently owning content production at enterprise scale — communications strategies, training curricula, job aids, quick reference guides, and stakeholder materials — without reliance on separate instructional design or communications resources.
• Proven ability to manage concurrent project workloads with overlapping timelines, shared stakeholder populations, and coordinated communication strategies to prevent audience fatigue and message conflicts.
• Strong proficiency applying ADKAR or equivalent structured change methodology in fast-paced program environments within condensed go-live timelines and high stakeholder expectations.
• Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones, with demonstrated ability to coordinate content production and delivery for international audiences including localization requirements.
• Strong executive communication skills — comfortable drafting communications on behalf of senior procurement and technology leadership for enterprise-wide distribution.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Change management certification — Prosci ADKAR, ACMP, or equivalent.
• Experience supporting Coupa Supplier Information Management or Ironclad CLM implementations with direct knowledge of platform capabilities sufficient to explain change impacts to business users.
• Demonstrated experience supporting contract management or CLM platform migrations, including user training design, workflow change communications, and adoption tracking for legal and procurement contract management populations.
• Experience with Marketing Cloud or similar enterprise communication platforms for stakeholder communication delivery and campaign management.
• Background in retail, consumer goods, or multi-brand procurement environments with understanding of category management, supplier diversity, and global sourcing operations.
• Experience managing OCM coordination with system integrators and vendor-delivered content, including quality oversight and delivery timeline management for SI-produced training materials.
• Familiarity with SharePoint as a training repository, project communications platform, and change management resource distribution system.

jobs.title: Cloud and Infrastructure Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Job Title: 
Cloud & Infrastructure Systems Administrator 


Contractor Position 




Revision Date: 9/29/2025


 




Summary 
DCWATER's DIT team is looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Systems Administrator to manage and optimize our hybrid cloud environment. This role is for a forward-thinking IT professional who is passionate about infrastructure, automation, and leveraging modern cloud and AI platforms to drive efficiency and reliability. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our server and virtual environments, from initial design and deployment to ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
Responsibilities 
Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure Management: Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS environments. This includes managing virtual machines, networking, storage, and identity services across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure. 
Automation and Scripting: Develop and maintain automation scripts using tools like PowerShell, Python, and Terraform to provision infrastructure, automate routine tasks, and enforce configuration consistency. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to manage infrastructure efficiently. 
AI for Operations (AIOps): Utilize AI-powered monitoring and log analysis platforms such as Splunk and Azure Monitor to proactively detect system anomalies, predict potential failures, and automate incident response. 
Containerization and Orchestration: Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them with Kubernetes to ensure scalability and high availability. 
Security and Compliance: Enforce security policies across all platforms. This includes managing identity and access controls with Azure Active Directory and modern IAM solutions, ensuring data encryption, and conducting regular security audits. 
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Design, implement, and test modern disaster recovery and business continuity plans for both cloud-native and on-premise systems to ensure minimal downtime and data loss. 
Virtualization and Server Administration: Administer VMware vSphere and Windows Server environments, ensuring they are patched, secure, and configured for optimal performance. 
Collaboration and Improvement: Work closely with development and security teams in a DevOps and DevSecOps culture to streamline workflows and implement continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Provide technical expertise and mentorship to junior staff. 
System Intelligence and Machine Learning: Collaborate with data science teams to integrate intelligent agents and machine learning models for infrastructure optimization, capacity planning, and automated resource allocation. 
 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in a systems administration or similar role within an enterprise environment. 


Proven expertise in managing and administering cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS). 


Strong experience with automation and scripting, particularly with PowerShell and/or Python. 


Experience with Microsoft Azure Entra ID, API Management, Front Door, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, Application Proxy Gateway, Data Gateway. 


Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform. 


Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, specifically VMware vSphere. 


Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms like Docker and Kubernetes. 


Familiarity with AIOps tools and principles for predictive analysis and automated monitoring. 


Knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, Power Platform, Intune, MECM/SCCM. 


A foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, intelligent agents, and their practical application in an IT infrastructure context. 


Solid understanding of modern networking concepts, including hybrid cloud connectivity, security groups, and load balancing. 


Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and modern identity management. 


Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and provide effective solutions. 


Relevant certifications are a strong plus, especially Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or VMware Certified Professional (VCP). 


Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience and certifications.

Role Overview:

We are seeking experienced ATE Test Development Engineers to support  mixed-signal IC validation and production test development initiatives.
This role will focus on advanced ATE solutions using the Cohu DxV platform, with contributions across multiple programs.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in mixed-signal semiconductor testing, deep hands-on experience with Cohu DxV, and the ability to operate across both modern and legacy test systems.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop, debug, and optimize ATE test programs for mixed-signal ICs
• Lead test development on Cohu DxV platform (primary “workhorse” ATE system)
• Support validation and production test
• Collaborate with design, validation, and product engineering teams to ensure test coverage and quality
• Perform characterization, correlation, and yield improvement activities
• Support test migration and coexistence between legacy and modern ATE systems
• Develop documentation for test methods, hardware interfaces, and program flows

Required Technical Skills

ATE Platform Expertise (Critical)
• Strong hands-on experience with Cohu DxV (required)
• Familiarity with multi-site, high-throughput test architectures
• Experience in:
o Test program development and debugging
o Device interface board (DIB) bring-up and validation
o Instrument control (analog/digital resources)
o Test time optimization and parallelism strategies

Expanded: Cohu DxV Experience Expectations
Candidates must demonstrate deep functional and operational knowledge of the Cohu DxV platform, including:
• Test Program Development:
o Writing and optimizing DxV test programs using native development environments
o Implementing complex test flows for mixed-signal devices
o Debugging test failures and improving coverage
• Mixed-Signal Instrumentation Use:
o Configuring and using analog and digital instrument resources
o Handling precision measurements (ADC/DAC validation, voltage/current accuracy)
o Synchronizing digital pattern generation with analog measurements
• Hardware Integration:
o Working with Device Interface Boards (DIBs) and probe/load boards
o Debugging signal integrity and hardware/software interactions
• Production Readiness:
o Optimizing test time and multi-site efficiency
o Supporting yield ramp and production qualification
o Performing correlation between bench, validation systems, and ATE
• Debug & Optimization:
o Root cause analysis of test failures (hardware vs software vs design)
o Improving test robustness and repeatability

IC & Domain Expertise
• Experience with 16-bit to 32-bit IC architectures
• Strong understanding of mixed-signal systems (Analog + Digital)
• Familiarity with:
o ARM Cortex-M0 or similar embedded processors
o Sensor-integrated ICs (accelerometers, sensing elements)
o Signal acquisition and conditioning circuits

Functional Test Knowledge
• Testing and validation of:
o Pacing engines
o Signal sensing circuits
o Accelerometer-based systems

Additional / Preferred Skills
• Experience with Credence D10 (legacy ATE systems)
• Ability to work across multiple test platforms and legacy environments
• Background in medical devices or implantable electronics (strong plus)
• Experience with test method migration from legacy to modern ATE systems

Ideal Candidate Profile
• 4+ years of experience in ATE test development (mixed-signal focus)
• Proven expertise in Cohu DxV platform (must-have)
• Strong problem-solving skills in test/debug/production environments
• Ability to adapt to complex, multi-program semiconductor projects

jobs.title: BSW Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Role name: BSW Embedded Engineer
Work Location: Mountain View, CA (On Site)
Type of hire: Contract
Role Overview:
We are seeking a Sr. Staff Embedded Software Engineer with strong experience in QNX and/or Android device driver development, board bring-up, and low-level hardware integration on Automotive IVI and Connectivity ECUs. This role focuses on platform enablement, driver development for multimedia/connectivity subsystems, complex HW/SW debug, and production-readiness support through DV and end-of-line phases.
 
Key Responsibilities
% of Time Responsibility:
35% Platform Bring-Up & Device Driver Development

Lead board bring-up activities on Qualcomm SoC-based IVI / connectivity platforms
Develop and debug kernel/device drivers and BSP components (QNX or Android/Linux)
Enable core subsystems (boot chain, clocks/resets, storage, power sequencing) needed for platform readiness
Collaborate with HW teams on schematic/DT review and interface validation
25% Hardware–Software Integration & Debugging
Debug complex HW/SW interaction issues across drivers, firmware, and peripherals
Perform root-cause analysis using tracing/logging and lab instrumentation; drive issues to closure
Partner with suppliers and cross-functional teams to resolve platform defects and unblock integration

10% Cross-ECU Coordination & Platform Services

Support integration topics spanning IVI ECU and connectivity/MCU components (e.g., power and wake coordination)
Define and document low-level interfaces, assumptions, and bring-up checklists to improve repeatability

20% Production Readiness & Validation Support

Support DV/PV and manufacturing readiness (flashing, diagnostics hooks, stability fixes, performance tuning)
 Improve observability and robustness (error handling, watchdogs, recovery paths) for production deployments
Provide on-site/remote support during critical integration builds and validation events as needed

10% Technical Leadership & Best Practices

Mentor engineers and contribute to design/code reviews with an emphasis on quality and maintainability
Drive best practices for driver architecture, testing strategies, and documentation
Continuously improve bring-up workflows, tooling, and automation where applicable

Mandatory Skills:
Required

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills for complex embedded systems
Clear written and verbal communication; able to align across hardware, software, and validation teams
Collaborative mindset; effective in cross-functional and cross-company environments
Ownership-driven execution with a high bar for code quality, documentation, and reviews
Ability to mentor engineers and establish best practices for bring-up and debugging
10+ years of embedded software development experience
 Strong experience in QNX (7.1/8.0) or Android BSP / Linux kernel development
Hands-on experience with Qualcomm automotive SoCs (e.g., SA8155P, SA8255P, or similar)
Experience developing and debugging kernel drivers and/or HAL layers (C/C++)
Board bring-up experience including bootloaders, device trees, and low-level initialization
Deep understanding of interrupts, DMA, memory mapping, clocks/resets, and power management
Strong hardware debug skills using logs, tracing, and lab tools (e.g., JTAG)

Optional Skills

Master’s degree in a related technical field
Experience in automotive IVI / digital cockpit systems
Experience with multimedia subsystems (audio, display, camera) and/or connectivity (USB, Ethernet, BT/Wi‑Fi)
 Experience supporting DV, PV, and EOL / manufacturing phases
Familiarity with NXP S32K microcontrollers and cross-ECU power coordination
 Experience with FreeRTOS or microcontrollers
 Safety awareness: familiarity with ISO 26262 concepts
